passages.text:
Re: Twitter Spaces Event w/ Samantha Power
[contact omitted] Vivian Nguyen Thursday, April 28, 2022 at 4:37:24 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Maany Peyvan
hahah yep! We got all of their organizations verified too. Thank YOU for connecting us! What an awesome thing we could
do to help elevate them on the platform, even after the event.
On Thu, Apr 28, 2022 at 4:35 PM Maany Peyvan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
This is so fucking great. This is for all the Ukrainian journalists?
On Thu, Apr 28, 2022 at 4:22 PM Vivian Nguyen <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks so much, Caroline!
On Thu, Apr 28, 2022 at 3:54 PM Caroline Strom < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Update for you - All of the accounts have now been verified, so the blue badge should be appearing on each. I
would recommend including each of the handles in a lead-up Tweet for speaker visibility, as well.
Don't hesitateto let meknow if you have any additional questions in the meantime.
On Wed, Apr 27, 2022 at 3:33 PM Caroline Strom < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thank you! Will be here when it is all set.
On Wed, Apr 27, 2022 at 3:17 PM Vivian Nguyen <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Caroline,
Thanks so much for those updates and for verifying the accounts. I just reached out to [contact omitted] and l'll let you
know when she has uploaded a header photo to her account.
Vivian
On Wed, Apr 27, 2022 at 3:09 PM Caroline Strom < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hello! Yes, it was such a pleasure meeting you all.
Verification. Thank you for sending over. I have passed these along to the team for further review from
here, with the exception of [contact omitted] who needs to quickly add a header photo.
Technical Questions. To your questions raised yesterday:
• Downloading audio file: The download will be in a .ts file format, which you can easily convert into an
audio file like.mp3 or.wav, or even a video. However, there are no transcriptions included.
• Data analysis: Currently, there is not a way to download a list of all the participants who joined the
Space. I can share additional metrics from my side, though # of people who opted-in for a reminder is
also not currently available.
Amplification. Working on the Twitter account amplification, and we will be flagging for the team on
additional discovery points.
Don't hesitate to let me know if you have any additional questions.
On Wed, Apr 27, 2022 at 7:07 AM Vivian Nguyen <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Caroline,
Thanks so much for meeting with us yesterday! Following up on the request for verification, it would be
awesome if Twitter could verify these handles prior to the event:
[contact omitted]

[contact omitted]
[contact omitted]
[contact omitted]
[contact omitted]
Thank you!
On Fri, Apr 22, 2022 at 1:59 PM Caroline Strom < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds great! I'll keep an eye out for the calendar invitation.
On Fri, Apr 22, 2022 at 1:06 PM Vivian Nguyen <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Caroline,
Nice to meet you and thank you for helping us promote our event! It looks like Tuesday 11:30 would
be best for us. I can send you a calendar invite in a few minutes.
Thanks!
On Fri, Apr 22, 2022 at 12:55 PM Caroline Strom < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thank you for the introduction, Michele.
Hi team - So nice to meet you all! This sounds like such a great conversation, and I would be
happy to help in any way.
Let's schedule some time next week to walk-through the latest Twitter Spaces updates and we can
review any questions and tactics there.
Do any of the following times work for you all?
Monday, April 25
11:00am -12:00pm EST
Tuesday, April 26
11:30-12:30pm EST
1:00pm - 2:00pm EST
Speak soon!
Caroline
On Fri, Apr 22, 2022 at 12:13 PM Michele Austin [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hello again Maany:
Connecting you here with Caroline Strom, part of our global innovation team. She will support
you for the event.
Over to you Caroline!
Michele
On Fri, Apr 22, 2022 at 10:41 AM Maany Peyvan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Yep, thanks! So the space will be run out of [contact omitted] and the participants will be:
• USAID Administrator Samantha Power, [contact omitted]
• InterNews Moderator: Gillian McCormack [contact omitted] Internews Director in Ukraine
• Oksana Romaniuk, [contact omitted] Director of the Institute of Mass Information (IMI),
[contact omitted]
• Angelina Kariakina, [contact omitted] Head of Ukraine public broadcast news (UA:PBC),
[contact omitted]

• Volodymyr Yermolenko, [contact omitted] Ukrainian philosopher, analyst and
journalist, chief editor at [contact omitted] [contact omitted]
On Thu, Apr 21, 2022 at 4:49 PM Michele Austin < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Oh my gosh how great is this!
Yup let me talk to the gang and get back to you next week. Do you mind sending me what
handles this is coming from?
Michele
On Thu, Apr 21, 2022 at 4:47 PM Maany Peyvan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Michelle!
Not sure if you remember but we met a couple times back when I was at the Obama
Foundation to organize Twitter conversations during Black History Month and
International Women's Day.
I work at USAID now along with all of the amazing people cc'ed, supporting Administrator
Samantha Power, and we've lined up a Twitter Spaces conversation for her and some
Ukrainian journalists on World Press Freedom Day, on May 3.
I'm wondering if we could connect with you and see if this is something you all would be
interested in helping us promote, or discuss other collaborations and cool partnerships w
could consider. I feel like there's plenty of overlap in terms of what we could do, so let u
Thanks,
-Maany
